title: Valid email is accepted and redirects to the thank-you page
steps: Scroll to the site-wide footer newsletter signup form
expected_result: Browser performs a full-page redirect to `/thanks-for-subscribing-to-our-newsletter/`, displaying "Thank you for signing up for our newsletter" and "Be on the look for an email from us." A stale default inline confirmation may flash briefly during the AJAX-to-redirect transition on slow loads — note this if observed, but it does not affect pass/fail.

title: Empty email submission is rejected with a required-field error
steps: Scroll to the site-wide footer newsletter signup form
expected_result: Form displays the inline error "This field is required."; no redirect to the thank-you page occurs.

title: Malformed email format is rejected with a format error
steps: Scroll to the site-wide footer newsletter signup form
expected_result: Form displays the inline error "The email address entered is invalid, please check the formatting (e.g. email@domain.com)."; no redirect to the thank-you page occurs.

title: Whitespace-only value in the email field is not accepted as valid
steps: Scroll to the site-wide footer newsletter signup form
Enter three space characters in the email field
expected_result: Submission is not treated as successful — either the required-field error ("This field is required.") or the invalid-format error is displayed; no redirect to the thank-you page occurs.

title: Plus-addressed valid email is accepted like any other valid address
steps: Scroll to the site-wide footer newsletter signup form
expected_result: Same success behavior as a plain valid address — full-page redirect to `/thanks-for-subscribing-to-our-newsletter/` with the standard thank-you messaging.

title: Resubmitting an already-subscribed email succeeds identically (idempotent, no differentiation)
preconditions: The test email address has already been submitted successfully once before (e.g. reuse the address from TC-NEWSLETTER-SIGNUP-001 after it has run).

test_data.email: user@gmail.com (same address as a prior successful signup)

steps: Scroll to the site-wide footer newsletter signup form
Enter the previously-subscribed email address again
expected_result: Redirects to `/thanks-for-subscribing-to-our-newsletter/` with the identical success messaging as a first-time signup — no "already subscribed" differentiation, by design.

title: XSS/script-injection string in the email field is not executed
steps: Scroll to the site-wide footer newsletter signup form
expected_result: No JavaScript executes (no alert dialog); the payload fails email-format validation and the form displays the standard invalid-email-format error, same as TC-NEWSLETTER-SIGNUP-003. No redirect occurs and no server error is triggered.

title: Very long email string is handled without a server error

test_data.email: 244 lowercase 'a' characters followed by '@gmail.com' (254 chars total)

steps: Scroll to the site-wide footer newsletter signup form
Enter the 254-character email string in the email field
expected_result: No server error (no HTTP 500, no crash). Either the form accepts it and redirects to the thank-you page like a normal valid address, or it is rejected with the standard invalid-email-format/length error — either outcome is acceptable as long as it is handled gracefully.
